best_for: Short-form creators making TikTok, Reels and Shorts on a Windows PC or Mac who want auto captions and AI tools, and accept that export options sit behind Pro.
description:
CapCut Desktop is the computer version of CapCut, the video editor from Bytedance Pte. Ltd. It is built to go with Dreamina Seedance 2.5, an AI video model: you make clips with it, then cut and finish them on CapCut's timeline.

Smart search finds clips in your media by the objects, people or words in them. You can add trending effects and templates, and send a finished video to YouTube in one click. Projects saved to your Space open on your other devices, so you can pick up an edit wherever you are. A CapCut plugin also works inside ChatGPT and Codex.

points.title: Free to edit, Pro to export some things
points.text: If a project uses Pro-tagged items such as exclusive templates, effects, fonts, music or AI tools, export stops until you subscribe. On desktop, 4K, 60 fps and no-watermark export options are locked for non-Pro users.

points.title: What Pro costs
points.text: Pro is listed at USD 19.99 per month or USD 179.99 per year, and Ultra at USD 79 per month or USD 900 per year, both with 1 TB of cloud storage. CapCut says displayed prices are for reference. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Captions and AI built in
points.text: It writes captions from speech, reframes video for new aspect ratios, and has script-to-video and AI writing tools, along with keyframes and color wheels.

points.title: Runs on old systems
points.text: CapCut lists Windows 7 or later, with Windows 10 recommended, and macOS 10.14 or later.

points.title: Who makes it
points.text: CapCut is published by Bytedance Pte. Ltd., the company behind TikTok. It is closed source with no Linux version.

points.title: Install notes
points.text: The Windows installer is x64 only and installs for the current user. The Windows listing keeps 91 versions; macOS lists only the current universal build.
